params.name: activityId
params.description: The identifier of the activity. It is the correlation ID given to the ingestion/process/format order request.

items.docs:
Hold activity and set activity status to `ON_HOLD` only for manual activities such as control or physical delivering.

If the activity is already terminated (status `ARCHIVED`, `CANCELED`, `FAILED` or `SUCCESSED`), the response is an HTTP `400` error code.

This endpoints **should not be forged** but retrieved from the `_links` map in list activities response or any endpoint that create or modify an activity.
